visualizationDefinition: This visualization builds a quantum circuit from the Boolean expression and then uses Grover's algorithm to find a bit string x such that f(x) = 1.
source: Brassard, G., Hoyer, P., Mosca, M., & Tapp, A. (2000), Quantum Amplitude Amplification and Estimation

solver.solverDefinition: This solver builds the expression as a quantum circuit and then uses Grover's algorithm to probablisticly detemine a solution

timeComplexity.Description: oracle queries, where v is the number of boolean variables in the formula
